digital_visual_essays.notes: Six visual essays N-006–N-011. Original schematic SVG/JS visualizations are editorial diagrams, not records of artwork, biological sampling or field walks. They contain no copied third-party images except 3 existing Met/CC0 images in N-006, tracked above.
digital_visual_essays.source_attributions: Each essay lists primary institution links; third-party copyrighted artworks are referenced by link without copying.

2026-10-17.notes: The six SVGs in the proposed homepage are original AI-assisted editorial studies, not executed art works or documentation of field research. Anna Atkins Ulva lactuca (OA-020) is reused under documented CC0/Open Access.

homepage_2026_10_17.description: Live homepage redesign focused on drawing and visible editorial projects; includes an optional interactive canvas. Canvas initial strokes are a generated, AI-assisted digital study and are not attributed as physical artwork by Diego Bravo. Visitor strokes remain in-browser and exported PNGs are local.
homepage_2026_10_17.rights_separation: Historical public-domain reproductions are differentiated from digital editorial graphics, visitor-made drawings and original physical artwork. No original artwork was fabricated.
